snapshot.text: Tax-funded National Health Service (SNS) alongside private and social-sector providers. Pressure points are emergency departments, surgery waiting times and patients stuck in hospital waiting for continuing-care places.

priorities.title: Stricter rules for extra surgery
priorities.text: Staff may do paid extra surgeries only after a minimum baseline of regular activity, with the same price per procedure in public, private or social-sector facilities.

priorities.title: Regional obstetric emergency services
priorities.text: The government is setting up the first regional emergency departments for obstetrics and gynaecology.

priorities.title: Climate-related contingency plans
priorities.text: SNS bodies must have yearly plans for heatwaves, cold spells and wildfires, with four alert levels.
